properties.name: Río San Juan de Dios (buried 1909)
properties.kind: Buried river · under Calzada Independencia
properties.desc: Piped (embovedado) from 1909; runs under Calzada Independencia; open channel in the median of Av. Normalistas; rises at Parque Agua Azul. The city's founding river: it rose at Agua Azul and ran through the centre past the Mercado San Juan de Dios. Today it is a sewer-and-storm collector you cannot see.
